svg.text: Business Process Model and Notation · sanctuary operating loop (aligned to current main)
Supplier = external data only (no login lane) · ROP recommends only (no auto-PO) · Realtime refresh is not a process step
Submission: pending → approved → received → stocked · rejected from pending only · Stock-out: waste | expired | adjustment
New vs prior diagram: Forgot Password, Currently Needed, Staff Accounts, walk-in Add Donation, Average Daily Use wording
